{{Quote|Master, Dooku can't actually believe this&mdash;this redroot-and-stick approach is going to work, can he? Not when he's got droid detachments occupying Lanos?''"<br />"''Not occupying. Liberating. From its crushing servitude to the corrupt and decayed Republic. Or haven't you been paying attention to the HoloNet?|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
The '''Lanos system''' was located within [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated in the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[Askar Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and contained the location [[Lanos]].<ref name="Wild Space" /> During the first [[Standard year|year]] ([[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]) of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Wild Space Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' and the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]</ref> the system was the site of a [[Battle of Lanos|battle]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the battle, a detachment of Confederacy [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] occupied Lanos, which some on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] described as liberating Lanos from its crushing servitude. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]&mdash;both of whom served the Republic&mdash;briefly discussed the occupation of Lanos while reviewing the Confederacy's approach to the war.<ref name="Wild Space" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Lanos system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]],'' a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] that placed the system in grid square Q-14.<ref name="Atlas" />
